boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named MSOE places for meeting, studying, making, recreation, and campus culture, each supported by a current official source.

cards.title: Campus Center
cards.subtitle: MSOE's social hub and dining commons
cards.notes: Use the Campus Center as a practical meeting point to chat, play games, or eat together; check current building access and dining details first.
cards.short_summary: A documented social center where students can meet, play games, and use the dining commons.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE describes the Campus Center as the center of social life where students meet to chat, play games, or eat at the dining commons.
cards.access_notes: Follow current building-access and dining guidance.

cards.title: Walter Schroeder Library
cards.subtitle: Study rooms, research resources, and collaboration space
cards.notes: Book a study room when your group needs privacy, or choose a reading area for solo work; bring your MSOE ID for entry.
cards.short_summary: Library space for individual study, group collaboration, research, and academic help.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE states that Walter Schroeder Library has spaces to research, study, and collaborate, including bookable study rooms.
cards.access_notes: MSOE states that visitors are required to scan an MSOE ID to enter.

cards.title: Raider Center for Academic Success
cards.subtitle: Tutoring, writing help, and study space in the library
cards.notes: Pair a focused study session with tutoring or writing help, and use the center's library location as an easy handoff between support and work.
cards.short_summary: An academic-support destination with tutoring, writing help, and study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE states that the Raider Center for Academic Success is located in the library and provides tutoring, writing help, and study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current academic-support availability and library entry requirements.

cards.title: Kern Center
cards.subtitle: Recreation, athletics, health, and wellness facility
cards.notes: Plan an active break around the fitness center, track, or a recreation program, and bring your MSOE ID for the facility's front-desk check-in.
cards.short_summary: A large campus recreation facility with fitness, athletics, and wellness services.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE identifies the Kern Center as a recreation, athletic, health, and wellness facility with fitness, arena, field house, and track spaces.
cards.access_notes: MSOE requires members to present an MSOE ID at the front desk; academic-year hours run Monday–Thursday until midnight.

cards.title: Pamela and Hermann Viets Field
cards.subtitle: Competition field for soccer, lacrosse, and club rugby
cards.notes: Watch a scheduled match or arrange an outdoor break around open availability; review the official calendar because practices and events can close the field.
cards.short_summary: An MSOE competition field used for soccer, lacrosse, and club sport rugby.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE identifies Pamela and Hermann Viets Field as an NCAA Division III competition field for soccer, lacrosse, and club sport rugby.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year field hours are listed through 9 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 8 p.m. Friday–Sunday; availability changes with events and weather.

cards.title: Grohmann Museum
cards.subtitle: Art collection documenting the evolution of human work
cards.notes: Take a deliberate gallery break with classmates, then use the visit page to confirm current hours and admission before arriving at Broadway and State.
cards.short_summary: MSOE's museum has three gallery floors devoted to art about human work.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE states that the Grohmann Museum holds more than 1,700 paintings and sculptures documenting organized work and includes three gallery floors.
cards.access_notes: Current hours are posted by the museum; admission is purchased at the desk or online, with free entry listed for MSOE students with ID.

cards.title: Grohmann Museum Rooftop Sculpture Garden
cards.subtitle: Rooftop extension of the museum's work-themed collection
cards.notes: Add the rooftop garden to a museum visit for a change of scene, and confirm that gallery access and any event-specific restrictions allow rooftop viewing.
cards.short_summary: A rooftop sculpture garden and green roof atop the Grohmann Museum.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE describes the Grohmann Museum rooftop sculpture garden as an extension of its collection and a green roof.
cards.access_notes: Access is through the museum and subject to current visitor procedures.

cards.title: Diercks Computational Science Hall
cards.subtitle: Named academic building on the MSOE campus
cards.notes: Use the building as a precise project-meetup destination before class, then follow posted access rules and department guidance for rooms and labs.
cards.short_summary: A named campus academic building listed on MSOE's official buildings page.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE lists Diercks Computational Science Hall among the buildings on its campus.
cards.access_notes: Room and building access vary by course, event, and time of day.

cards.title: Applied Technology Center
cards.subtitle: MSOE academic facility for applied technology work
cards.notes: Use this named destination to orient a class or project-team meetup, and check with the relevant department before expecting access to specialized equipment.
cards.short_summary: An MSOE academic facility highlighted for its applied technology equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE identifies the Applied Technology Center as a campus facility where students access a fluid-power and motion-control training unit.
cards.access_notes: Specialized facilities and equipment may be limited to scheduled academic use.

cards.title: Allen-Bradley Hall of Science
cards.subtitle: Classrooms and engineering laboratories on campus
cards.notes: Meet outside before a lab or lecture, then use the building's listed departments and labs to confirm where your course or appointment is located.
cards.short_summary: A science and engineering building with classrooms, laboratories, and department offices.
cards.evidence_claim: MSOE states that Allen-Bradley Hall of Science and the Fred Loock Engineering Center house classrooms and more than 40 laboratories.
cards.access_notes: Laboratories and classrooms are used according to course schedules and departmental access rules.
